remarks: Timeles charm and great location. This Beautiful Tudor is located within walking distance of schools, shops and park. Toquam Magnet around the corner. Dolan down the street. Barrett Park just two blocks away. Highlights: Bright and cheerful home office, study or guest room, welcoming foyer. Energy efficient with gas heating & Navien tankless system for hot water on demand; energy-efficient Pella Windows. Upgraded electrical panel. Charm and character with delicate modern paint palette give a feeling of elegance and softness. Gleaming hardwood floors and lighting fixtures accentuate the house's ambiance. Two full baths, large kitchen with attractive cherry cabinets, sparkling backsplash and granite counter tops. Stainless steel appliances. Nicely sized rooms and closets. Finished attic with room for for couch. Wrap-around yard. Garage. Superb location. Easy access to the Merritt and I-95. Not to be missed! Good credit, references required. Cats welcome. Smaller dog per case base.
